messages:
marco: Quick check — planning to enable region_failover_v2 for eu->na fallback with session_affinity_ttl=20s for the chat API. Canary 5% EU users. Anyone object? Need to schedule during low traffic window.
sophie: Sounds good. Which endpoints are in scope? chat.generate and /v1/stream?
marco: Yes — chat.generate + /v1/stream. Also excluding chat.history. Plan to apply these flags via the feature-service: 
```
/ff toggle region_failover_v2 --scope chat.generate,chat.stream --exclude chat.history --canary 5 --regions eu=100,na=0 --meta '{"session_affinity_ttl":20,"fallback_order":["eu","na"],"max_kv_age_ms":5000}'
```
kevin: Can we make session_affinity_ttl 15s instead? Shorter TTL reduces stale sticky routing. Also add guardrail: don't trigger failover if observed latency > 400ms (avoid thrashing).
iris: Oncall FYI — I'll run the canary smoke tests once rollout starts. @deploy-bot can you create the rollout and tag it with #safety-check?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout created for region_failover_v2 canary=5% (eu). scheduled start=1850212500. tags=[canary, safety-check].
evan: Note — sticky sessions are stateful for chat.history; good call excluding it. Also double-check kv-cache TTL interaction with session_affinity_ttl.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Preflight summary: cluster health OK, KV cache hit-rate 92%, avg p95 latency 210ms. no critical alerts.
sophie: Ack. I will monitor error_rate and latency dashboards. If error_rate > 0.5% or p99 spikes > 800ms we roll back immediately. I'll set alerts now.
marco: :thumbsup: Starting canary in ~10m and will post back when active. Leaving rollout window 2h for observation.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary active @1850212600. Traffic routing: 5% EU -> region_failover_v2. Initial logs: no error surge in the first 10m. tag=canary-eu-1850212600.
iris: Running smoke: create conversation -> PASS, stream handshake -> PASS, streaming latencies 120-300ms. KV miss rate unchanged. No regression so far.
kevin: If green for 30m, plan to ramp to 30% over 30m, then 100% after 2h. I'll update the rollout plan and add the latency guardrail in the policy.
marco: Thanks team — keeping this thread open for followups and observations. Will post rollback if anything crosses thresholds.
